name: tax-and-audit
description: Tax strategy and audit-readiness for small business owners and real estate investors. Five skills: quarterly estimate calculator (Q1-Q4 federal + state), cost segregation analysis for RE properties, entity structure recommendation (LLC vs S-Corp vs C-Corp), audit-prep document checklist and readiness scorecard, and a deduction finder that scans QuickBooks Online data for missed deductions. Integrates with the qbo-bookkeeper plugin for live transaction data. NOT TAX ADVICE — this plugin organizes and educates; always confirm with a CPA before filing.
